statement: Logarithmic and Lp Brunn–Minkowski inequalities and the B-conjecture. Proves the logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski inequality for origin-symmetric convex bodies in every dimension, and the scalar-dilation B-conjecture for all even log-concave Radon measures. For Lebesgue volume it also proves the additive Lp Brunn–Minkowski inequality for full-dimensional origin-symmetric convex bodies throughout $`0\lt p\lt 1`$.
